title: Landing hero screenshot fix and post-Internet Identity loading recovery

requirements.summary: Replace the landing hero phone mockup screenshot with the user-selected image and ensure the hero uses the same crop/fit behavior as the landing carousel.
acceptanceCriteria: Landing hero phone mockup (component: frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScreenshotShowcase.tsx) no longer displays the FunnAI Game Nest screen.

The hero phone mockup displays the chosen replacement image (using the user-provided upload) and uses the same fit behavior as the carousel (object-cover / centered) so it looks consistent with the other carousel images.
Only the hero phone mockup screenshot content is changed; the phone frame, notch, sizing, and dot controls behavior remain intact.

file_operations.description: Update the hero mockup `screenshots` source list to use the selected replacement screenshot (matching one of the landing carousel images) and keep the same `object-cover object-center` presentation so the hero phone screen visually matches the carousel; do not change the phone frame/notch/dot control behavior.

requirements.summary: Prevent infinite post-login loading by making initialization/profile loading state finite and adding an error + retry UI when profile fetch fails.
acceptanceCriteria: After completing Internet Identity login, the app transitions into a usable state (either main app UI or Profile Setup when no profile exists) rather than remaining on the loading screen indefinitely.
If loading the caller profile fails (e.g., query error), the UI does not remain stuck on the spinner; it renders an error message in English with a visible “Retry” action that re-attempts loading.

The loading screen in frontend/src/App.tsx only appears while initialization or profile fetch is actively in progress; it does not persist due to disabled/blocked queries (e.g., missing actor) without surfacing an actionable UI state.
Manual QA: login from the landing page header Login button and from the app-mode login screen both result in the app opening normally after authentication.

file_operations.description: Adjust `useGetCallerUserProfile` to expose explicit state for actor dependency readiness (e.g., actor-ready vs actor-unavailable) and ensure loading flags accurately reflect whether a profile fetch is actually in progress (not merely blocked by missing actor). Use the selected "authorization" component guidance for actor-dependent queries and profile setup gating; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update initialization gating so the full-screen loading UI renders only when authentication initialization or the profile query is actively running; if profile loading fails (react-query error) or cannot start due to missing actor readiness, render a clear English error state with a visible Retry action that re-attempts loading (e.g., by calling the profile refetch and/or invalidating relevant queries) instead of leaving the user on an infinite spinner. Leverage the existing reusable error UI from frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx for consistency.
